Emerging from behind the lower-left corner of the yellow B-shape is a small cartoon mascot character — a simplified bear with round brown head (#c08040), small sleepy or curious eyes rendered in flat 2D vector style, visible only from the upper body upward. The bear's small brown paw is barely visible at the lower-left edge of the B-shape, as if the character is peeking or hiding behind the mark. The bear has no visible text or brand markings and is purely a playful mascot element. To the right of the yellow B-mark, occupying the right third of the frame (approximately 55-80% of frame width), are two lines of Korean Hangul text set in a bold rounded sans-serif typeface. Layout: the entire logo group (B-mark + bear + text) is centered in the frame both horizontally and vertically, with generous blank navy space above (approximately 35% of frame height), below (approximately 35% of frame height), and on both sides. The composition is purely symmetrical around the vertical axis with the logo group placed at the visual center. Color palette: navy background #2e3650 dominates approximately 75% of the total frame area; brand-yellow #f0c820 occupies approximately 13% (the B-mark); white typography #ffffff occupies approximately 9%; bear mascot brown #c08040 occupies approximately 3%. Texture: all elements are flat 2D digital vector, zero photographic texture, zero film grain, zero halation. The aesthetic is a Korean fintech mobile brand identity motion graphic — clean, modern, minimal, hi-key flat digital, playful mascot integrated into logo mark.
